name: md-anything
description: Convert anything to Markdown — CLI, MCP server, and HTTP API

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts src/mcp.ts src/server.ts --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run test:required
scripts.test:required: bun test tests/unit tests/integration/cli-json.test.ts tests/integration/cli-ux.test.ts tests/integration/convert-text.test.ts tests/integration/convert-image.test.ts tests/integration/ingest-source-manifest.test.ts tests/integration/url-fallback.test.ts tests/integration/usefulness-metadata.test.ts tests/integration/youtube-fallback.test.ts
